---
format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    pdf-engine: lualatex
    geometry:
      - letterpaper
      - margin=0in
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{graphicx}
        \usepackage[absolute]{textpos}
        \setlength{\TPHorizModule}{1in}
        \setlength{\TPVertModule}{1in}
        \pagestyle{empty}
        \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
        \setlength{\fboxsep}{0pt}
        \setlength{\fboxrule}{0.3pt}
        % ---------------------------------------------------------------
        % BACKSHIFT moves the BACK card DOWN the page (inches; negative = up).
        % 0 = front and back in exactly the same place on the page.
        % A 0.75 in shift was tried on 2026-11-11 with the Microsoft IPP Class Driver and made
        % the offset WORSE (~10 cm), so that driver doesn't place pages linearly. Keep 0 and
        % fix the driver; remeasure with notecard-alignment-test.pdf before changing this.
        \newcommand{\BACKSHIFT}{0}
        % ---------------------------------------------------------------
        \newcommand{\cardat}[3]{% page, label, top edge of card (in)
          \begin{textblock*}{5in}(1.75in,#3in)
          \fbox{\includegraphics[page=#1,width=5in,height=3in]{notecard-3x5.pdf}}
          \end{textblock*}
          \begin{textblock*}{5in}(1.75in,1in)
          {\footnotesize\sffamily #2. Cut along the box. Print at 100\% / Actual size, duplex, flip on long edge.}
          \end{textblock*}
          \null}
---

```{=latex}
\cardat{1}{FRONT}{4}
\newpage
\cardat{2}{BACK}{\fpeval{4+\BACKSHIFT}}
```
